chunks: Zurārah and Bukayr narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them:
Regarding two people in the state of ihram who struck game, he, peace be upon him, said: “Upon each one of them is the expiation.”

key_terms.الْفِدَاءُ: the required expiation or compensatory offering
key_terms.مُحْرِمَيْنِ: two persons in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: If two people in ihram hunt game together, does each one have to pay expiation separately?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about two muhrims who jointly hunted or injured game while in the state of ihram. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the expiation is due separately from each individual, establishing personal liability for each participant.
